widgets_values: Genre: cinematic indie pop. BPM: 92. Key: D major. Emotional progression from lonely and reflective in the verse to hopeful and wide in the chorus. Vocals: clear female lead vocal, intimate in the verse, stronger and layered in the chorus, soft backing harmonies. Arrangement: muted piano and warm pad in the intro, fingerpicked electric guitar in the verse, brushed drums and deep bass entering in the pre-chorus, full cinematic drums, wide synth pads, and bright guitar textures in the chorus. Production: clean modern mix, spacious reverb, gentle stereo width, no harsh distortion.

[Intro]
The room is quiet, the tape begins

[Verse]
Dust on the speakers, rain on the glass
I count the seconds that refuse to pass
Your photograph leans by the phone
Like a small bright country I cannot call home

[Pre-Chorus]
Then the bass line starts to rise
And the dark turns blue behind my eyes

[Chorus]
Turn the radio louder, let the old roof shake
We are building a morning from a midnight mistake
Turn the radio louder, let the cold wires sing
There is still a little thunder in everything

[Bridge]
No map, no signal, no promise to keep
Only headlights moving through the sleep

[Outro]
The room is quiet, the tape runs thin
But something warmer is coming in
